The same frozen file asserts the opposite at line 239 ("E_C0 contains E_H2loc contains E_{C^1,1} contains E_C2"), lines 241-244 (four one_way_entailments) and line 250 (subsumption_note), and the sibling F2a at its line 152 records the identical denial as wrong ("the earlier 'no containment with C2 is asserted' was wrong"). A reader resolving the denial as a claim about the artifact reaches the forbidden-transfer direction. Rev13's revision_history index 11 declared no class-semantics change, so the sentence is an unrepaired carry-over from rev12.

hard_failures.finding: The reason string states "C2 is a strictly larger extension class, so C2-inextendibility is strictly weaker". Under the file's own containment (line 239) E_C2 is the innermost, strictly smallest extension set, so the size premise is inverted; the prohibition itself (rule_spec R16) and the "strictly weaker" conclusion are correct, and line 225 already labels C2/C1/H2_loc conclusions WEAKER. The sentence is therefore internally incoherent in a frozen implication ledger: premise and conclusion do not connect under either reading of "extension class".
hard_failures.disposition: metadata-only repair candidate: replace the premise with the smaller-class direction (or drop the premise, keeping the prohibition); same moving-target rule

findings.finding: The motivating obstruction and the tier_2 witness example use exact stationary (Kerr) vacuum data, but topology.forbidden excludes slices with more than one AF end and slice_topology requires a complete slice diffeomorphic to R^3; the standard complete Kerr/Schwarzschild maximal slices are two-ended, so exact Kerr data are not obviously admitted by this artifact's own D2. The quantified negation over the declared D2 is internally correct, and the field is marked citation_status=unresolved and L1-owned, so this does not void the verdict on its own; it is a scope note for the next metadata-only patch (cite an admissible one-ended extendible family, or restate the bullet as true of a broader two-ended AF class).

The independent i_plus C^k (k>=3) assumption and the Sobolev/pointwise-rates reconciliation are declared as assumed and 'recorded not resolved'. No hidden assumption found; the two fields are the only assumption-completeness soft spots a careful reader would want the formulation lead to keep visible.
